description:
What a US ETF / fund HOLDS: top holdings with % of NAV, sector (GICS) and country weights, plus the fund facts
    — AUM, expense ratio, benchmark / index or active, holdings count, top-10 concentration, tracking difference
    (SEC N-PORT / N-CEN filings; `as_of` dates say how fresh). Use it for "what does SCHD hold", "how concentrated is
    QQQ", "SPY vs VOO fees", "sector mix of XLE". ETFs rarely have news of their own — for "why is it moving" pair
    this with stock_impact / pulse on the top holdings. Non-fund tickers → `not_a_fund`.

context.description: OPTIONAL but RECOMMENDED — paste the user's FULL request VERBATIM (any language: 'ขอราคาผลไม้ apple', 'compare Apple and Microsoft stock'). The server uses it to disambiguate which candidate each `ticker` entity means (the apple COMPANY vs the fruit COMMODITY; which Samsung). One context per call, shared by all tickers here.
context.title: Context

ticker.description: A Ava Advisor ticker OR a company/asset NAME — the SERVER resolves it (no lookup step). A COMPANY/proper NAME passes AS-IS in any language (茅台/トヨタ/삼성 resolve natively — never translate a name); a generic COMMODITY/SECTOR concept must be ENGLISH (黄金→'gold', 原油→'crude oil'). Pass the user's full request in `context` to disambiguate ('apple' company vs fruit); if still ambiguous you get a `needs_confirmation` with candidates — resolve from conversation or ask, then re-call. Exact tickers pass through (Ava Advisor suffixes: Korea .KO, Taiwan .TW, commodity .COMM, crypto .CC, FX .FOREX, bond .GB, rate .MM).
ticker.title: Ticker

top.description: How many top holdings to list (default 15, max 50).
top.title: Top
